card.name: Small words before patient groups or doses
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas and symbols in dosing text, such as "for" before a patient group or "as" before "clinically indicated". Also fires on a comma in a list of dose days and on partway-through spots in words like intrathecal.

modes.label: Linking word before a group
modes.description: The word "for" comes right before a patient group such as adults or pediatric patients.

modes.label: Dose schedule or formula piece
modes.description: A comma, multiplication sign or unit ending inside a list of days, a formula or a weight-based dose.
modes.example: (1 - 2 minutes per injection) as two 5 mL injections, one in each buttock, on Days 1, 15<<,>> 29, and once monthly thereafter

modes.label: Inside intrathecal
modes.description: The ending of the word intrathecal in dosing headings.
modes.example: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Neoplastic Diseases For intrathe<<cal>> and high-dose methotrexate
